About Iron Circle

Every job starts with bare metal.

Iron Circle Sandblasting strips paint, rust, and old powder coat off just about anything that'll fit through the shop door — from a single rusted grill grate brought in by hand to a full set of roof rack parts or a classic car body ready for its next coat.

Customers keep telling us the same two things: the pricing is fair, and the work gets done faster than anywhere else in the area. We'd rather explain exactly what we can do for a part before we touch it, then get it back to you clean and ready for paint or powder.

What we do

Blasting and stripping, done for the part in front of us.

Every material takes a different touch. Here's the work that comes through the shop most.

Powder Coat Removal
Full strip-back to bare metal on wheels, calipers, brackets, and hardware — clean enough to go straight into a fresh color, from a factory black to a custom candy finish.
Wheel & Brake Prep
Beadlock wheels, alloy rims, and brake calipers blasted and prepped so the new finish — gloss black, copper, candy, whatever you're chasing — lays down even.
Classic Car & Chassis
Full bodies, floor pans, subframes, and chassis rails stripped down to raw steel for restorations and builds — ready for bodywork, epoxy primer, or powder.
Patio & Outdoor Furniture
Cast aluminum and wrought iron furniture sets blasted clean of old paint and corrosion, ready for a fresh powder coat that'll hold up outside again.
Commercial & Site Work
On-site surface prep for concrete, planters, and architectural steel ahead of coating or resurfacing — we bring the equipment to the job.
Small Parts, Walk-In
Bring in a single rusted part and we'll often turn it around while you wait — no job too small to quote honestly and blast right.
